_comment: unity-dev — SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for path -> codemap shard. SKILL.md, build_codemap.py and build_index.py all read this file; none of them carries its own copy of the mapping. First matching pattern wins, so order matters: Editor before UI/Gameplay, catch-all last. Patterns are gitignore-style globs relative to the project root: ** crosses directories, * stays inside one segment. Mirrors the folder layout in .claude/blueprint.md — change one, change the other in the same task.

shards.name: editor
shards.note: editor-only tools: level editor window, sprite import pass, map exporter; never in a build

shards.name: tests
shards.note: unit tests; kept out of gameplay so a test file never masquerades as a rule

shards.name: content
shards.note: content-driving code; the DATA assets themselves live in assetmap.md

shards.name: core
shards.note: catch-all: boot, scene flow, save, audio, haptics, settings
